name: bloom-and-blossom
description: Bloom & Blossom - Modern and Elegant Flower Shop Website

scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'script.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f)); console.log('Build complete: Files copied to dist/');"

author: Bloom & Blossom Team
